apps.name: Coodesker
apps.short_description: Coodesker is a desktop organization tool specially developed for office workers. It automatically sorts shortcuts, directories, pictures, and other files on the desktop. In addition, it does not contain unnecessary content such as advertisements and plugins and is very lightweight and safe.

apps.name: DAN☆SING
apps.short_description:
DAN☆SING! is a tool to help you create music video with your avatar with few clicks.
You would upload your VRM avatar file, VMD motion file, webM video and music into it.

This provides alternative solution to Miku Miku Dance. There is a lot of improvement space. We will keep pushing the boundary.

apps.name: Edify Non-linear editing system
apps.short_description: Edify is a non-linear video editor for Windows. Edit HD and 4K videos in landscape or portrait, with AI speech-to-text, background removal, text-to-speech, four-camera multicam editing, subtitles, and audio mixing tools.

apps.name: inFlight ATC
apps.short_description: Talk to air traffic control with your own voice. inFlight ATC adds AI controllers to Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 and 2024: hold push-to-talk, make the call, hear the reply. Clearance to taxi-in, live traffic on frequency, SimBrief plans. One-time purchase, no subscription.

apps.name: Student Station
apps.short_description: Organize your studies with focus, clarity, and full control of your routine in an environment designed for high performance.

apps.name: Velis
apps.short_description: Velis is a local media library manager. Browse and organize images, videos, audio, and documents on your PC using real folders and virtual tags. Search, filter, rate, and annotate assets, then review them in flexible gallery layouts and an immersive viewer—without uploading your files to the cloud.

apps.name: Death By A Thousand Drones Playtest
Fractured Online Realms of Growth Eternal, FORGE Playtest
Car Mechanic Shop Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Manage a prosperous car shop empire and enter the complex car maintenance and repair world. This simulation game offers a comprehensive, in-depth experience that combines strategic business management with the technical nuances of car maintenance.

apps.name: Carnival Stand Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Grill it. Load it. Hand it over. Carnival Stand Simulator drops you behind the counter of a midway hot dog stand where the line never really ends. Serve fast, sell out, and build the busiest pitch at the carnival.

apps.name: Depth Above Demo
apps.short_description: An atmospheric horror game inspired by classics from the 2000s. Playing as William in his constant search for Lynn, he ventures into all kinds of obscure places. With Lynn's last note as a guide, his goal remains, taking him through many places with creatures and environments shaped by corruption.

apps.name: DONUT PANIC Demo
apps.short_description: Order up! DONUT PANIC is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

apps.name: FERALPALS Demo
apps.short_description: Feralpals is a chapter-based mascot horror game. Humanity was wiped out by a pathogen linked to Friendly Pals, genetically engineered creatures, granted human-like intelligence to serve mankind’s ambitions. The Pals are now left behind, imitating their creators' society long after humanity vanished.

apps.name: Gun Center Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Enter the world of a gun shop as a passionate collector who opens his own gun center! Create and manage your own gun center where you trade, customize and sell firearms, from classic pistols to cutting-edge weapons.

apps.name: Herbal Haven Demo
apps.short_description: In this life-sim, you are sent by the adventurer’s guild to run a local infirmary. Explore diverse biomes to gather ingredients, nurture your herbs and concoct remedies to aid your guild. Build relationships with your neighbors and engage in community events.

apps.name: Home Invaders Demo
apps.short_description: Fight through infinite and increasingly difficult waves of home intruders and gets the highest score possible. Use a variety of fighting strategies, some of which utilize melee and ranged weapons.

apps.name: House Cleaner Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: House Cleaner Simulator Demo - build your own cleaning empire! Unlock tools, take on bigger jobs, and clean your way to fame and fortune in this unique demo version of house cleaning simulator!

apps.name: Meowzic Survivor Demo
apps.short_description: A rhythm-integrated roguelike that fuses survivor-style gameplay with dynamic music mechanics. Your firepower flows directly from the rhythm, meaning your combat build is also your custom game music. It’s time to conquer the universe with your own rhythmic symphony of destruction!

apps.name: Mixxpell Demo
apps.short_description:
Mixxpell is a 1v1 wizard fighting game full of flashy spells and fast-paced fun.
Create a powerful combination of magic to overpower the opponent, or a clever build to mess with them.
Dodge and weave around your opponent's magic and prove that you're better than everyone!

apps.name: Please Drive Faster Demo
apps.short_description: Drive fast. Brake carefully. Don’t ask what’s in the box. Please Drive Faster is a delivery driving game about tight deadlines, fragile cargo, roadside inspections, and getting paid. Take riskier jobs, upgrade your vehicle, and keep the cargo intact long enough to cash out.

apps.name: POUND SAND Demo
apps.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

apps.name: Project: Centurion Demo
apps.short_description: Explore the systems of derelict spaceship using the Linux command line. Learn the fundamentals of text manipulation, explore the file system, and repair the systems of the ship using the Linux terminal.

apps.name: Refill Demo
apps.short_description: Play the first three chapters of Refill. Pour, sort, and fill a pill organizer week after week as one woman's life unfolds through the notes and packages that arrive. About 40 minutes. No timers, no pressure.

apps.name: Revenge of the Firstborn Demo
apps.short_description: Lead a party of heroes through a long-forgotten valley. Find an ancient mausoleum and destroy the monsters within it to discover a clue to the origins of the mysterious Firstborn.

apps.name: Scarlet Deer Inn Demo
apps.short_description: An embroidered dark medieval folk tale. While life in a seemingly ordinary village is all about simple chores and idle gossip, sinister secrets hide below.

apps.name: SeverLink Prototype
apps.short_description: SeverLink is a retro stealth action, inspired by the console classics of the early 2000s like Splinter Cell, MGS2-3 and Hitman Contracts. With the art direction emulating the distinct look of the Playstation 2 library of games.

apps.name: Shopkeeper Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Take on the role of a manager in the most addictive simulation game - open the doors to your supermarket and build it from scratch, transforming a small shop into the ultimate supermarket!  Become a great manager and make your store outstanding.

apps.name: Snow Cone: The Inside Scoop Demo
Supplice Demo
apps.short_description: This might be a trial, but it’s not a drill. Supplice is a brutal retro sci-fi FPS with fast combat, complex multi-level maps, and a unique style mixing 90s shooters with modern design. Blast diverse enemies with hard-hitting weapons across four full-sized maps and get a taste of the main game.

apps.name: Tavern Rivals Demo
apps.short_description: Tavern Rivals is a synergy-heavy PvP auto battler where every synergy has a body holding it up. No team health bar, on either side — so protect the minions your engine runs on, and go through the ones holding theirs together.

apps.name: The Birdwatcher's Journal Demo
apps.short_description: Photograph and identify birds on a mysterious island. Each bird you discover brings you one step closer to uncovering what happened to the researcher before you, and the secrets of the island.

apps.name: The Mystical Traveler Demo
apps.short_description: In The Mystical Traveler, you play as a cosmic cube in a 2D pixel art platformer. Master gravity, explore planets, unlock characters, and overcome various challenges in a mysterious universe.

apps.name: Tunnel Brawl Friend Pass
apps.short_description: Join a friend who owns Tunnel Brawl and play complete underground tank duels for free. One owner can invite one Friend Pass guest into the same lobby and 1v1 match. Practise solo, then dig, flank and fight in the same arena.

apps.name: Undershroom Demo
apps.short_description: Take a bite of surreal psychological horror. Explore a world where familiar places twist, reality slips, and your own eyes can't be trusted. Uncover what happened and dare to discover what lies beneath the shroom.

apps.name: Wild West Miner Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: You've become the sheriff of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. apps.name: ふまんぐーる 体験版
万圣节之眼Halloween Eye Demo
apps.short_description: Halloween Eye is a text-based adventure game set in a modern alternate-history city with light fantasy elements. Through the perspective of the protagonist, Grey, players will witness the kindness and harshness of human nature, as well as the evolution and fate of the city.

apps.name: 五局司 Demo

apps.name: 塔防兵工厂 Demo

apps.name: Hunter: Sexy Legacy - Chapter 4
apps.short_description: The tournament finals have arrived, and Hunter is ready to prove himself. Find out what happens in Chapter 4 of Hunter: Sexy Legacy!

apps.name: Hunter: Sexy Legacy - Halloween Special
apps.short_description:
Halloween Special: The Beast Within
For generations, his family has hunted the creatures of the night. But an ancient sickness continues to plague their bloodline, and he may be the one destined to put an end to it.

apps.name: Hunter: Sexy Legacy - Support DLC
apps.short_description:
For those who want to support the game even further!

This DLC gives you the "OG Supporter" achievement, which unlocks the extra content gallery.

apps.name: In My Bubble •° - Say Cheese!
apps.short_description: A new adventure awaits in the peaceful world of dreams! Capture frozen moments with a magical camera and enchanted film. Focus, and say cheese! What surprises await when you press the shutter?

apps.name: Merry Glade. Original Soundtrack.
apps.short_description:
Merry Glade. 
Original Soundtrack.

apps.name: Need For Speed Most Wanted - Premium Modification Unlock
apps.short_description: Premium Mod Unlock means you'll instantly own Pro Mods for every car in the game.

apps.name: Orcavan: Idle RPG - Starter Pack!
apps.short_description: Give all six units Black Crow appearances, double their attack damage and max health, and claim 10 Divine equipment pieces.

apps.name: Plushy Store Tidy Up - Plushy Barn Achievement Pack
apps.short_description: Celebrate your time in Plushy Barn with 43 optional achievements. Complete every plushy’s shelf in Relaxed or Challenge mode, finish both modes, and earn the Plushy Barn Completionist achievement.

apps.name: Red Eye Empire - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Double your airline’s operating income forever and unlock the Dart SST — a fictional supersonic jet exclusive to supporters. Own the pack to enjoy a permanent ×2 operating income boost across your entire airline.

apps.name: Resident Evil 0 Costume Pack 1
apps.short_description: This pack contains Rebecca's cheerleader outfit from Resident Evil: Deadly Silence and a Wolf Force crossover costume for Billy.

apps.name: Resident Evil 0 Costume Pack 2
apps.short_description: This pack contains Rebecca's nurse outfit from Resident Evil: The Mercenaries 3D and a Street Fighter Alpha 3 Cody crossover costume for Billy.

apps.name: Resident Evil 0 Costume Pack 4
apps.short_description: This pack contains Rebecca's classic S.T.A.R.S. 1996 outfit from the original Resident Evil and her never-before-seen prototype outfit from the original Resident Evil 0.

apps.name: SCUM Weapon Skins 1
apps.short_description: Introducing the SCUM weapon skins pack! This cosmetic DLC will let you customize your weapons to better camouflage them – or just express your personality. With 14 patterns to choose from, each of them customizable with different paints, the sky is the limit on how your weapon can look.

apps.name: Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts - Multiplayer
apps.short_description: Grab your Sniper rifle and join the fight in the multiplayer mode!

apps.name: STAR WARS Zero Company™ Deluxe Edition Upgrade
apps.short_description: Unlock unique cosmetic items inspired by the Clone Wars™ era with this upgrade to the Deluxe Edition of STAR WARS Zero Company™.

apps.name: The Last Faith: Awakened Ancients
apps.short_description: Awakened Ancients delivers long-awaited content, answers, deeper challenges and the most polished version of The Last Faith to date.

apps.name: Настоящие пазлы - Дом на природе
apps.short_description: «Real Puzzles — Nature Estate» is a meditative puzzle game that will transport you to a world of absolute tranquility, privacy, and architectural luxury. It allows you to literally build the house of your dreams piece by piece.

apps.name: Настоящие пазлы - Каньоны: Дом на природе (изображения)
apps.short_description: High-quality images of beautiful houses, used in the "Real Puzzles - Secluded Manor" expansion.

apps.name: Настоящие пазлы - Котята: Морские обитатели (изображения)
apps.short_description: High-quality images of cute fish used in the "Real Puzzles - Marine Life" game.

apps.name: Настоящие пазлы - Морские обитатели
apps.short_description: Dive into a vibrant underwater world! Assemble cute puzzles with friendly fish, funny octopuses, and other sea creatures. Perfect entertainment for kids and the whole family!

apps.name: עובד העיריה הנעלם הגרסה העברית
apps.short_description: משחק הרפתקה בלשית לגבי להסיק מסקנות גדולות מרמזים קטנים. כל חפץ, אמרה, ואי עקביות יכולים לחשוף את כל האמת אם אתם יודעים לחבר את הנקודות. תחקרו את היעלמות עובד העיריה שבלעה אותו האדמה בגרסה בדיונית של העיר תל אביב

apps.name: 凡修—功法自动修炼
apps.short_description: Unlock automatic gongfa training. Queue multiple techniques, rotate after each completed layer, and consume matching pages automatically. Skip unavailable techniques and keep progressing offline, with progress settled when you return.

apps.name: Alchemy Duel
apps.short_description: Alchemy Duel is a card game that combines elements of alchemy and roguelike gameplay. Alchemize monsters suited to the situation and unleash powerful combos by making use of synergies between your cards!

apps.name: Almanac: Detective Agency
apps.short_description: A narrative detective game about solving mysteries through investigation, evidence, and conversation. Question suspects in your own words, photograph clues, and piece together the truth in a town full of secrets. Who is lying, and what are they hiding?

apps.name: Always With You
apps.short_description: "Always with you" is a cute and relaxing action-puzzle game. Switch freely between controlling a girl and a cat, solve clever puzzles, explore the ancient Alto civilization, and defeat unruly guardians. Embark on an exciting adventure with three cats to find your mother!

apps.name: Amazing Sumo Boat Adventure
apps.short_description:
A sumo wrestler,a boat, and a mountain. Use physics-based ropes and just two mouse buttons to climb
your way to the top. Master the controls, overcome ridiculous challenges, and try not to fall!

apps.name: Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl
apps.short_description: Command the siege or lead a royal escape in Ancient Moves: Hnefatafl, a Viking strategy board game. Capture the king with 24 attackers or break through with 12 defenders and their king. Play solo against four AI difficulty levels or challenge a friend on the same device or online.

apps.name: Antiutopia
apps.short_description: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

apps.name: ARCHETYPE BLUE
apps.short_description: Archetype Blue is a JRPG-style role-playing game that blends the fun of building your party and planning strategies with an engaging story. Mix and match companions with unique abilities and personalities to form your own party and enjoy the thrill of strategic battles!

apps.name: Auto Immune
apps.short_description: A virus is attacking your cells, and its up to you to defend them! Buy and combine cells to assemble your immune response. Discover powerful synergies to overcome a constantly evolving enemy in this physics-based auto battler. Can you achieve IMMUNITY?

apps.name: Badger Tactics
apps.short_description: You stole and lost your sister's favorite figurines. Get them back or face her wrath! Fight, collect, and track down the missing figures before SHE finds you. In this retro turn-based tactical RPG, your fate is decided by the roll of the dice!

apps.name: BUBBA PEG SURVIVORS
apps.short_description: A co-op survivors-like roguelite for 1-4 players, online or on one couch! You build the peg board that does your shooting: walls and pegs stay for the run, shiny pegs multiply balls, and a ball fires the bucket it lands in. Merge 70 weapons to tier 6 and earn rare hats and pets: real Steam items.

apps.name: BunnyGalSanta-バニーギャルサンタ-
apps.short_description: "Welcome home~ Look! I bought a bunny-Santa costume just for tonight♡" Spend Christmas Eve with your gyaru girlfriend in this intimate 3D simulation. Drive the "round-and-round piston system" with mouse drags, raise her satisfaction to unlock new positions — reach 100% for a special present♡

apps.name: Cheese, Please!
apps.short_description: Steal cheese from the Cat Empire in an incremental bullet hell. Dodge deadly bullet patterns, collect resources, and invest your haul in permanent upgrades. Unlock dozens of weapons and perks, experiment with powerful builds, and take on increasingly dangerous bosses.

apps.name: CHESS2
apps.short_description:
CHESS, BUT...  

NO TURNS, 

NO CHECK OR CHECKMATE, 

CAN'T MOVE THE SAME PIECE TWICE, 

10×10 BOARD, 

2 EXTRA KNIGHTS & PAWNS, 

PAWNS MOVE IN ANY DIRECTION

apps.name: Cinder
apps.short_description: Cinder is a particle sandbox with physics simulations, you can create a house out of wood, bricks, concrete and set the wood on fire, see if it gets hot enough to melt the concrete into lava and then try to put it out with water. You can react acids against materials or grow plants in dirt.

apps.name: CitySpotter
apps.short_description: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

apps.name: click to ten 3D
apps.short_description: the number rises, in 3D

apps.name: CORE//PULSE
apps.short_description: Defend a stationary Core against escalating waves of geometric enemies. Build each run with upgrade cards, satellites, orbital weapons and automated skills, defeat unique bosses, earn currency, and return stronger for the next run.

apps.name: CRIMSON GATE
apps.short_description: A roguelite RPG where auto battler meets tower defense! Summon and deploy 30 battle dolls. Grow your legion with gear and card combos, and take on the final boss waiting at the end of 100 waves.

apps.name: Crystal Cub
apps.short_description: Crystal Cub is a retro inspired cozy exploration game. Assume the role of Biggie the Bear who stumbles upon a magical library and discovers all of its secrets!

apps.name: CUFFED
apps.short_description: Awaken deep inside a ruined underground lab with your wrists permanently bound. In this combat-free survival horror, your shackles are your only tool. Solve systemic puzzles, override security systems, and outsmart the terrifying specimens hunting you to escape.

apps.name: Cyber Volleyball
apps.short_description: Cyber Volleyball is a side-scrolling 2D volleyball game with realistic physics and character progression. Players serve, spike, block and dig under strict three-hit rules. It features over a dozen characters with unique AI skills, adventure mode, online multiplayer, and nine upgradeable attributes.

apps.name: Dark Age: Tokens of the Fallen
apps.short_description:
A single-player medieval dungeon-crawler RPG where you battle bandits, defeat powerful bosses, collect souls to upgrade your skills, and recover fallen tokens to unlock new dungeons and the road to the King’s fortress.
WISHGATE-2PZF0DQG

apps.name: DDGame
apps.short_description: 多人卡牌对战游戏DD成王全新登场！这是一款类自走棋的卡牌游戏，玩家通过抽牌和换牌组成强大牌型主宰战场，体验策略与运气的融合与碰撞！

apps.name: Deeper...
apps.short_description:
"Deeper..." is a short game about an obsessed diver.
Diving accumulates DEEP, which you can spend to enhance your next dive.
Your wife will faithfully wait and assist you but how long will you keep her worrying?

apps.name: Doji Run: Stock Market 3.0
apps.short_description: Welcome to Stock Market 3.0. DOJI RUN is a real-time cyberpunk stock market roguelite deckbuilder: play chips onto a live 60-second chart, draw the lines the price bounces off, pump it, short it, and beat the boss the Exchange sends every Friday. 100+ edge chips. One rigged market.

apps.name: Dungeon Returns Department: Tidy Up The Backlog
apps.short_description: Dungeon Returns Department is a first-person tidy-up and factory automation game. Repair and shelve 11,346 returned items, unlock magic powers, and automate the work with conveyor belts, cannons, and drones. Play solo or with up to 5 friends online.

apps.name: eHUB cities
apps.short_description: The power grid has failed. You have no phone, no internet. Only the eHUB, your power source for emergencies. Your neighbors are counting on you — but what will you do? The story-driven simulation game “eHUB cities – Blackout” is being developed under the direction of the LOEWE Center emergenCITY.

apps.name: Endless Hunter
apps.short_description: An Auto Battler RPG. Pick four heroes from 30 classes and they fight across 48 lands on their own: they travel, clear dungeons, loot gear, and take each land's stronghold. You choose their skills, gear, scrolls, and potions. Every run earns Honor for permanent upgrades.

apps.name: Everlasting Curse
apps.short_description: Enter the witch’s hidden house, explore mysterious parallel worlds, switch between day and night, solve unique puzzles and minigames, uncover dark secrets, and break an ancient curse.

apps.name: Everyone Expire
apps.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you're the Dungeon Master and the party trusts you completely. Bait the room, rig the dice, and keep them alive just long enough to die at the boss. The paladin can't swim. The bard licks things. You've taken notes.

apps.name: FC Tycoon 2027
apps.short_description: A data-driven football management simulation where you take control of your club's journey — from tactics, scouting and transfers to finances and facilities. Build your philosophy, shape your destiny, and lead your team to greatness.

apps.name: Forsythia
apps.short_description: 1592, the Imjin War. Lead Yi Sun-sin, Gwon Yul, and other real commanders through seven years of war between Joseon, Ming, and Japan. Fight real-time encounter battles, command a fleet of panokseon warships, and craft your own equipment. A single-player campaign drawn from the historical record.

apps.name: Fruitzy
apps.short_description: Harvest all the fruit, clear every area of ​​the farm, and purchase equipment and upgrades from the shop to work faster. A calm, unhurried game. Perfect for relaxing at your own pace.

apps.name: Grain Master
apps.short_description: Enjoy a relaxing ASMR sorting experience in Grain Master! Sort grains one by one using chopsticks, upgrade your tools, improve your speed, and immerse yourself in a world of relaxation and enjoyment.

apps.name: Green Brigade
apps.short_description: Your childhood toy battles come to life. Lead Sergeant Rook against the Tan Army across an entire house in a story-driven campaign - flamethrowers, bazookas and tanks included - then take on Survival, Quick Battle, D-Day Invasion and Abominations, solo or in split-screen co-op.

apps.name: Grimsorrow Academy
apps.short_description: An idle RPG of dark academia and spellcasting dread. You signed the indenture, the page is still warm. Scry the mirror, stoke the umbra, attend your disciplines, and survive ten years. Do not feed the staircase.

apps.name: Grove Keeper
apps.short_description: In this Dark-Fantasy, RTS game, you play the role of a Forest Deity protecting your Grove against an onslaught of loggers, warriors and poachers. Use your powers to grow trees, summon guardians, set traps, and employ magic to defend, and eventually conquer your human oppressors.

apps.name: Heartwood TD
apps.short_description: A maze tower defense roguelite where every tower is also a wall. Plant Wardens to shape the path the nightmares walk, combine their powers into chain reactions, and grow a stronger maze with every run.

apps.name: Hellwake
apps.short_description: Your heroes fight on their own. You build the killing machine. A dark fantasy auto-battler RPG with deep classic loot: seven classes, uniques, sets and runewords, a town to raise, and runs you burn for permanent power as you descend through seven acts of Hell.

apps.name: Hose to Mars
apps.short_description: Your mission is to terraform Mars. However, a crash landing destroyed all your gear—leaving you with just a spoon! Start watering the soil with your spoon, earn MarsCoin, and upgrade your equipment. Turn the Red Planet green solo or with friends!

apps.name: HYPER DEEP THROAT
apps.short_description: A deepthroat-focused 3D simulation starring a busty maid. The "Swirl Piston System" turns simple mouse movement into real-time motion, with realistic gagging sounds and a visible throat bulge. 18 outfits, full face/body/color customization, free camera, and record & replay.

apps.name: HYPERINFLATION
apps.short_description: A survivors-like about a lone ship facing an endless horde. Shooting is fully automatic - you only decide where to fly. Build your loadout from upgrades, items, and crew, survive duels with elite enemies, and make it far enough to face the bosses.

apps.name: Incremortal: Xianxia Ascension
apps.short_description: An incremental game about Xianxia cultivation. Slay monsters, gather spiritual qi, refine elixirs, break through realms, and ascend to immortality.

apps.name: Just a Clicker Game
apps.short_description: Acquire energy. Build a city. Consume the universe. Just a Clicker Game is a darkly humorous incremental experience where your quest for efficiency might just break reality. Manage simulation instability, unlock the massive Neural Tree, and remember: the Ducky Council is always watching.

apps.name: Kingdom of Embers
apps.short_description: Real-time strategy meets action RPG. Build a kingdom and raise an army, then take the field as its ruler: lead your troops into battle in person, and delve into deadly dungeons for legendary weapons and world-ending spells.

apps.name: Lumanto
apps.short_description: A free fantasy RPG of hooded heroes and 350+ magical creatures. Play on your own whenever you want, or join a live stream's caravan from Steam or the Twitch chat. Build your heroes, tame creatures, forge gear and trade in a player market powered by Lúmen.

apps.name: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE!
apps.short_description: MAHOU SHOJO REVENGE! is a visual novel where you follow an ex-magical girl on a quest of revenge against her former squad mates that betrayed her.

apps.name: Meow Cards
apps.short_description: Meow Cards is a cat-themed strategic card game. Collect feline cards with unique abilities, build your very own Meow Cards deck, and climb to the top—together with your cats! Meow～

apps.name: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia
apps.short_description: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia is an idle martial arts game with a feline desktop companion. Master inner arts, mix skills, collect gear, and fight automatically. Refine your build, unlock meridians, and reach new realms as your cat pursues its heroic dream.

apps.name: Metalstorm
apps.short_description: Become a fighter pilot in Metalstorm, a fast-paced 5v5 air combat shooter. Customize your jet with unique abilities and upgrades, dogfight alongside your squad, and prove yourself against pilots around the world to become an Ace.

apps.name: Mindwarp: Island Detective
apps.short_description: Up to 4 players in online co-op. Talk to characters, learn their stories, search for clues and pass judgment before sunset in this unique detective.

apps.name: Mission to the Lost Galaxy
apps.short_description: Build your space station in this 1960s sci-fi city builder, where a galaxy of strange new worlds awaits! Manage an intrepid crew, meet bizarre alien species, and uncover the secrets of the lost galaxy.

apps.name: Necromage
apps.short_description:
Command an army of summoned minions as a necromancer in an isometric action RPG.
Strengthen your hero with powerful loot, enhance your minions through crafted spells, and lead rival factions to defeat brutal bosses.

apps.name: Neon Dreams
apps.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

apps.name: Night Glass: One More Tide
apps.short_description: Captain a rescue boat across a haunted Lake Erie. Fight what’s changing beneath the water—and bring people home. Rescue changing patients, recruit Avery, and upgrade your cannon, searchlight and hull. Follow Story’s rescue missions or brave Arcade’s branching encounters.

apps.name: Nine Layers: Escape
apps.short_description: Escape a sealed apartment building stalked by jiangshi. Explore nine floors and a basement, observe clues, solve puzzles, listen for danger and move quietly to evade pursuit. Play this first-person Chinese horror game solo or in LAN co-op with up to four players.

apps.name: No Humanity - Internship
apps.short_description: No Humanity - InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.

apps.name: NODEROID
apps.short_description: “NODEROID” is a roguelike game where the goal is to explore randomly generated pseudo-3D maps and defeat bosses. By incorporating randomness into every aspect—from turn-based combat to victory rewards and events—you can fully experience the “fun” of roguelikes.

apps.name: Offerings of Odin
apps.short_description: A roguelike twin-stick shooter where every floor lasts just 30 seconds. Survive a wave of enemies before making your escape to the next level. Upgrade your build, and jump straight back into bullet-hell chaos.

apps.name: Oustwit
apps.short_description: A tactical 1v1 board duel on a 6×6 grid where every piece you place shoves its neighbours. Line up three or deploy all eight to win. Quick online matches against players on PC and mobile, or play the AI offline. Outwit. Oust. Win.

apps.name: Path Of Peecho
apps.short_description: Fight the Pawtriarchy! The world has been dominated by the greediest cat the universe has ever known. Assemble your team of rebels, build their decks, customize their skill trees, and take Peecho down in this turn-based roguelite scramble to save humanity right meow.

apps.name: Pedro and Sofia's Nuclear Winter
apps.short_description: A fantasy adventure across a nuclear-torn America!  Play as Pedro and Sofia and set out on a quest in this open-world, 3D/2D role-playing game!

apps.name: Peeping Office Worker
apps.short_description: Step into the secretive Omnituens Corp. Find keywords in conversations to unravel mysteries, get promoted, and leverage your power to forge intimate bonds with the captivating women of the office.

apps.name: Please Drive Faster
apps.short_description: Drive fast. Brake carefully. Don’t ask what’s in the box. Please Drive Faster is a delivery driving game about tight deadlines, fragile cargo, roadside inspections, and getting paid. Take riskier jobs, upgrade your vehicle, and keep the cargo intact long enough to cash out.

apps.name: Print a Robot
apps.short_description: Print a Robot is a Shop Simulator game about 3D printing robot parts. Design the store to your liking, use various tools to create and modify your models and fulfill the orders of your fellow robots. Upgrade yourself to improve your process and increase your team in order to expand your business.

apps.name: Prism Drift
apps.short_description: Take control of a lone pilot in a hostile galaxy. In this incremental roguelike, every death is a lesson and every scrap of loot is progress. Battle through relentless waves of enemies, level up your skills, and return to base to turn your scavenged parts into ship upgrades.

apps.name: PRISON OF HUSKS
apps.short_description: Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. In this nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife, explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Battle lovelorn bosses and seek your lost love.

apps.name: Pro Yakyu Front Office
apps.short_description: Take charge of a fictional Japanese pro baseball club as general manager. Draft players on your scouts' judgment, set the lineup and the rotation, earn from sponsors and the ballpark, manage the payroll, and answer to the owner. The games play themselves; the decisions are yours.

apps.name: Project XX Queen
apps.short_description: This game that leans toward arcade action gameplay, incorporating moderate Roguelike and RPG elements. Experience an adventure story through simple and satisfying battles, purify the queens in danger together with your companions, build deep friendships with them, and save the world together.

apps.name: Pubes
apps.short_description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

apps.name: Quicksant
apps.short_description: A retro ant colony sim where your ants think for themselves. Place pheromone trails and your ants dig, haul, and build on their own, following the scent to work, food, or danger. Tunnel through a fully destructible world, farm the surface, outgrow the rival ant colony, and survive the dangers.

apps.name: Refill
apps.short_description: Refill is a cozy, hands-on game about the small ritual of taking care. Pour, sort, and fill a pill organizer week after week, following one woman's life through the notes and packages that arrive. Each week the pills change a little, and so does her life.

apps.name: Replay Rumble
apps.short_description: Fight alongside your past in a fast paced multiplayer arena! Every round adds your previous actions back into the battle, turning simple fights between four unique characters into ever growing temporal chaos.

apps.name: RoboFarm
apps.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

apps.name: rock[et]
apps.short_description: Destroy thousands of asteroids and repair your destroyed rock[et] in this cute incremental that's secretly 3 games in 1! Unlock game-changing skills, invent run-breaking synergies, employ a drone army, discover new planets, and much, much more.

apps.name: Rogue Link Loop
apps.short_description: Link matching tiles via paths with up to two turns. Clear tiles to cast spells, build structures, and summon allies. Diverse spells and relics ensure fresh runs. Counter unique elite disruptors.

apps.name: Shapesetter
apps.short_description: An open-ended puzzle game about building machines that make modernist art. Program mechanical arms to paint, cut and weld shapes into finished pieces, then refine your machine to be faster, smaller or cheaper.

apps.name: Shear Debt
apps.short_description: An active incremental game about shearing an increasingly odd flock, restoring the farm and building up upgrades that survive bankruptcy. Grandma’s farm is yours, debts and all. Even the Queen needs a trim.

apps.name: Silent Hunt: Horror Escape
apps.short_description: Investigate a house marked by a massacre, solve puzzles, and uncover what lurks in the darkness. But be careful… you're not alone.

apps.name: SINSTRUCK
apps.short_description: A co-op survival horror for 2 to 4 players. Earth is dying from climate change, and you've been sent to a new planet to survive. Nothing chases you, but something is watching.

apps.name: Sir, We have a Situation
apps.short_description: A deadpan military idle game. Command a battalion against absurd giant objects: a pigeon, a rubber duck, a bouncy castle, the Sun. Hire troops, build your camp, call in air strikes, and keep the paperwork in order. Sixteen targets. Command has noted all of them.

apps.name: Snow Cone: The Inside Scoop
apps.short_description: Make snow cones for customers. Solve challenging puzzles and uncover the secrets of the town.

apps.name: Sort & Sorcery
apps.short_description: Run a tiny magic shop at the edge of the woods. Every night a portal tips a mountain of potions, tomes, keys and curios onto the floor. Sort it all onto the right shelves before morning, chase off the thieving imp, and grow your little shop into the finest in the land.

apps.name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
apps.short_description:
S.O.S is a roguelike deck-building game built on blackjack.
Collect cards, build your deck, and turn the odds of blackjack in your favor.

apps.name: Sovereign Strike: Submarine Supremacy
apps.short_description: Become the captain of a Los Angeles-class attack submarine. Strike without warning, sink enemy ships with different torpedoes, dominate the global rankings, and explore a living underwater world packed with historical wrecks and forgotten secrets. Fast, tactical, and fun submarine warfare.

apps.name: Speedtickers
apps.short_description:
Speedrun your way trough short yet difficult levels before the timer hits zero.
Inspired by both the thigh controls from Celeste and the breakneck speed of Ultrakill, be prepared to push your reflexes to the limit with across 90+ handcraft levels, and a whole level editor.

apps.name: Starbump
apps.short_description: Starbump combines fast-paced action, Third Person platforming and competitive modes in vibrants worlds. It’s designed for party nights where you and your friends battle it out for hours, packed into colorful arenas and quick-fire game modes. It's a pure cozy brawl !

apps.name: STAROPHAGE
apps.short_description: Lead a recovery team into a silent research station in this turn-based tactical horror game. Choose what alien Seeds hatch into, use the station against its creatures, and uncover what happened aboard NEREID.

apps.name: Steal This Station
apps.short_description: Build your station. Defend it. Invade theirs. A sci-fi action RPG where you design a deadly space station filled with traps and enemies, then fight through what other players built to steal their loot. Every station is a target, including yours.

apps.name: Still Not Dead Yet
apps.short_description: 'Still Not Dead Yet' is a suspenseful horror-thriller text story inspired by H. P. Lovecraft.  In a dark mausoleum, a grieving professor performs an archaic ritual to resurrect his recently deceased wife.  The ritual succeeds, setting him down an unforeseen path.

apps.name: Super Doodle Mega War
apps.short_description: Bring your notebook doodles to life! Build an army of scribbled soldiers, upgrade and merge your auto-battling troops, and unleash skills against overwhelming enemy hordes. A roguelite auto-battler where one little doodle becomes a mighty army.

apps.name: SUPERCHESS
apps.short_description: Chess evolved. Burn, freeze, and poison enemies. Build your roster, master the tech tree, and dominate online, or practise your strategies offline against a fierce AI.

apps.name: Sylvan Tactics
apps.short_description: Chess pieces, card tricks. Deploy woodland Mercenaries from your hand, spring traps on your rival's turn, and bring their King's Health to zero. Free to play, with a guided tutorial, CPU opponents, and online matches with friends.

apps.name: Tactics and Cards
apps.short_description: Feel like a hero in a classic RTS! Build your army and crush the enemy team with spells, incremental upgrades, and tactics! Battle it out in a quick match against bots or friends in a 2D battle in the best traditions of auto-battlers, Tower Defense, and Castle Fight!

apps.name: The Bugs Manor
apps.short_description:
The Bugs Manor is a free 2D pixel art horror game. Explore a cursed mansion, hide from scary monsters, and solve puzzles with an inventory-free gameplay, focused on direct interactions with the environment.
Can you survive your first night in this haunted house and uncover its mysteries?

apps.name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
apps.short_description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

apps.name: The Gullible Genius Elf's Naughty Ordeal
apps.short_description: The genius elf Liz, self-proclaimed village prodigy, is an incredibly gullible beauty. She falls asleep guarding the sacred "Orb of Abundance" and lets it get stolen. Taking responsibility, the arrogant but temptation-prone elf embarks on a journey full of mishaps and lewd ordeals.

apps.name: The Necessary Evil
apps.short_description: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

apps.name: The Tower Must Fall
apps.short_description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

apps.name: Ticker Panic: Stock Market Simulator
apps.short_description: Trade in a chaotic stock market sim where absurd headlines, hype cycles, crashes, and liquidity traps can make or break your portfolio. Start small, survive the chaos, and take over the market.

apps.name: Tides of Annihilation
apps.short_description: Tides of Annihilation is an action-adventure game steeped in the legends of King Arthur. When an otherworldly invasion shatters London, Gwendolyn, a lone survivor, embarks on a desperate quest to fight back and uncover the truth that lies beyond the veil.

apps.name: To Pee or Not to Pee: พี พี่ พี้ พี๊ ผี
apps.short_description: A cute Thai horror anomaly game where you explore dark hallways with your flashlight, spot ghosts, investigate strange anomalies, solve spooky puzzles, and try to make it to the toilet without an accident!

apps.name: Treat Your Guest
apps.short_description: Investigate the rumors surrounding a Prestige Medical Tech Company, uncover a sinister plot from within, and survive the horrors that await equipped with a variety of weapons at your disposal.

apps.name: Trucker: Master Drivers
apps.short_description: Experience the realistic truck driving experience in Türkiye, and start your journey to becoming MASTER DRIVERS through realistic vehicle breakdowns and road experiences.

apps.name: Undying Echoes
apps.short_description: Build your own combat style in a single-lane 4v4 arena. Combine characters, weapons, and abilities, control vision, and push with your team to destroy the enemy core. Play with friends or practice against bots in Undying Echoes.

apps.name: Vape Empire Simulator
apps.short_description: Open a small vape shop and build it into an empire. Stock the shelves, price against a moving market, serve customers at the till, hire and train staff, mix your own e-liquids, repair devices and expand into a bigger store — on your own or with up to three friends in co-op.

apps.name: Vector Front
apps.short_description: Pilot a customizable starfighter into massive multiplayer fleet battles. Hunt enemy fighters, tear ships apart piece by piece, and lead assaults against enemy warships with your own customizable support fleet. Made for VR and PC.

apps.name: Voidwatch
apps.short_description: Voidwatch is a silky-smooth space shooter roguelike. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes!

apps.name: Wheel Wills
apps.short_description: A roguelike where every attack is a gamble. Spin the Wheel to decide what each day throws at you, fill your grid with Gambits that either hit or miss, and repaint the Wheel itself to bend the odds your way

apps.name: Whisperborne
apps.short_description: Turn-based collection JRPG on a continent the gods walked away from. Gather the lost heirs of the Sword-King, build a ten-slot weapon board for each of six elements, and raid alongside up to 30 players against the things still walking through Mira.
developers: Liufenyu Games 六分鱼游戏工作室

apps.name: Wuju Division
apps.short_description: A historical detective game mixing reasoning and puzzles, set during Northern Wei's early Sinicization reforms. As head of the Wuju Division, you're sent by the emperor to Pingcheng. Mysterious cases there seem unrelated but are deeply connected.

apps.name: Zero Gumbit
apps.short_description: A cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Play poker-style hands, stack Chips and Mult with 145 wild Jokers and break eight Antes of Boss Blinds. Swear risky vows in the Gambit, fuse Jokers at the altar. No gambling, no betting, no real money. Just combos.

apps.name: Zoomalia
apps.short_description: In a world conquered by Zealotory harvesters, Zoomalia’s survival rests in your hands. Build a team of over 100 unique creatures, then fuse, evolve, and mutate them into powerful forms. Adapt your strategy, destroy obelisks, and reclaim the planet in this strategic roguelite.

apps.name: [BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~ IDLE ~
apps.short_description:
■ Your Own Little Forge, Right on Your Desktop
[BoS] Blacksmith of Sword Master ~IDLE~ is an idle RPG that runs in a small corner of your desktop.
No matter what you're doing, the training never stops.
Start with a humble forge and rise to become the greatest martial arts master!

apps.name: 三文 Girl's Trifle Found
apps.short_description:
Two girls journey through a “world” where snow never stops falling, searching for a place where they truly belong.
 ——After losing their “worth,” how should one continue to live? The girl must make her choice…

apps.name: 修勾逃生搜打撤
apps.short_description:
**Dog Escape: Extraction Shooter**
A cute meme‑themed top‑down shooter‑survival game. Step into the paws of a brave pup, scavenge for supplies amid hostile forces and colossal bosses. Hunt for rare loot, upgrade your gear, craft high‑tier weapons, and grow from a nobody into a formidable fighter.

apps.name: 勇者传说：圣器再临
apps.short_description: 《Brave Saga: Artifact Reborn》is a customizable RPG game where you take on the role of a hero, search for suitable teammates to embark on an adventure together, find the seven legendary artifacts, crush the enemy's conspiracy, and ultimately defeat powerful enemies to save the world!

apps.name: 合成旅
apps.short_description: Combined Arms Brigade is a military FPS featuring in-game AI and roles such as riflemen, machine gunners and designated marksmen. Experience infantry squad combat, with more modes, maps and vehicles planned for the future. Grab your rifle and get ready for battle!

apps.name: 桜花ノ艦隊 1946
apps.short_description: A 2D scrolling shooter set in the Pacific theater. Fly as an Allied fighter pilot and take on the 「Empire of the Rising Sun」 overwhelming forces. Wipe out enemy units and turn the tide of battle.

apps.name: 欲望之都
apps.short_description: *City of Desire* is a vertical-screen, casual idle game set in a cyberpunk world.

apps.name: 歴史年号1000個覚えるまで出られないダンジョン
apps.short_description: An RPG where you climb into the past, aiming for the summit of historical date memorization.

apps.name: 汪里个狼 Wolf in Woof
apps.short_description: Wolf in Woof is a single-player Werewolf game where wolves hide among cute dog NPCs. Through speech, suspicion, alliances, voting, and deduction, players must uncover the hidden wolves—enjoying tense mind games without matchmaking or social pressure.

apps.name: 魄栈/Pozan
apps.short_description: An online adventure blending survival, exploration, character progression, and gear customization. Hunt powerful foes, collect epic loot, and battle other players in a shattered world bound by Black Mist. Follow ancient beacons on your journey to Hope Town.
developers: Hangzhou Di Er Yu Zhou Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Hangzhou Di Er Yu Zhou Technology Co., Ltd.

apps.name: 魔王城、迎撃準備中！
apps.short_description: Raise monsters by day and repel heroes by night. Discover over 300 species, breed new monsters, explore for gear, and grow closer to your companions. Place monsters and traps, then prepare for the hero’s main army on day 50 in this monster-raising management sim.

apps.name: CleanFall Soundtrack
apps.short_description: CleanFall's soundtrack focuses on atmosphere and originality. It contains a mixture of deep, powerful synths, orchestral swells, and various strange sound effects. While the soundtrack repeats certain stylistic choice, most songs are very unique when compared to the rest of the soundtrack.

apps.name: Dome Keeper Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Take your favourite dome tunes with you, wherever you go! Composed by Cameron Paxton, Dome Keeper features an enchanting original soundtrack that combines a mysterious atmosphere with an adventurous sense of wonder!

apps.name: Postmouse Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The Postmouse soundtrack features 28 minutes of original music composed for the game by composer and sound designer Carl Lindegaard

apps.name: Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Listen to the emotional handcrafted soundtrack of Silly Linguine Cat Simulator Deluxe Online!

apps.name: Terminidle Soundtrack
apps.short_description: W_W is the original soundtrack of Terminidle, an idle/clicker hacking game played entirely in a retro terminal. Five original tracks composed for the game.

apps.name: Настоящие пазлы - Каньоны: Дом на природе (аудиофайлы)
apps.short_description: Audio tracks from the game "Real Puzzles - Secluded Manor"

apps.name: Настоящие пазлы - Котята: Морские обитатели (аудиофайлы)
apps.short_description: Audio tracks from the DLC "Real Puzzles - Marine Life" for game "Real Jigsaw Puzzles - Kittens".
